subject: Mutual Action Plan Recap & Next Steps - Acme Systems MAP
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-25T15:10:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & MAP draft - next steps

Hi Jane and Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today - really appreciated the candid conversation. As promised, below is a concise recap of the key pain points, goals, decision process, and a proposed Mutual Action Plan (MAP). I attached a one-page MAP (acme-map-MAP-v1.pdf) and our security brief for your procurement team.

Quick recap of what we heard:
- Pain: High token costs and unpredictable latency on peak traffic for your user-facing assistant (esp. peak hours in EMEA).
- Impact: Support load spikes, degraded UX, and increased infra spend during launches.
- Current stack: Home-grown batching + inference service; capacity spikes are manual and slow.
- Goal: Reduce per-token cost by 30% and bring 99th percentile latency < 600ms for interactive queries.

Stakeholders / decision-makers we mapped from the call:
- Jane Doe (Product Lead) - budgeting & feature prioritization
- Tom Alvarez (Platform Eng Lead) - technical evaluation and POC owner
- Procurement TBD (legal & procurement for contract)

Proposed MAP (high-level milestones & owners):
1) Week 0 (this week): Share MAP + security brief (Marissa) - attached.
2) Week 1: Technical kickoff & data access checklist; run baseline perf (Tom + Monica).
3) Week 2-3: POC deployment in staging with 2 models; benchmarking and perf profile (Monica + Tom).
4) Week 4: Executive review & cost/ROI summary (Jane + Marissa + Rishi).
5) Week 5-6: Procurement negotiations & signature (Procurement + Dev Patel).

Decision process & timeline you suggested on the call: internal technical thumbs up -> exec sign-off -> procurement signature. You flagged May 20 as a target to have procurement complete if the POC looks good.

Requested next steps (from our side):
- Confirm access for staging (we need a service account and sample traffic window).
- Confirm two POC models you want us to run (we can recommend if you want).
- Proposed technical kickoff: Wed, Apr 28, 10:00-11:00 PT - does that work?

If this recap looks right, I'll update the MAP with the named procurement contact and a proposed demo window next week.

Thanks - looking forward.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acme-map-MAP-v1.pdf (1 page) - draft MAP; redwood-security-brief.pdf (3 pages)

From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & MAP draft - next steps

Thanks Marissa - this aligns with our notes. A couple quick clarifications: 

- Procurement contact is me for now; I'll loop in procurement (Esther Park) once we get internal tech sign-off.
- Decision committee: Jane (Product), Tom (Platform), Esther (Procurement), and Gabriel Lee (CFO) for final spend approval.
- Target: We would like to aim for procurement signature by ~2027-05-20 as discussed.

Tom and I are good for the kickoff on Apr 28 at 10 PT. Please include any specific data or access steps we should prepare (e.g., sample traffic, logs access).

Two questions from our engineering side: 
1) Can Redwood run a mixed-traffic baseline (interactive + background) so we can see tail latency under realistic load?
2) Any constraints around providing test data - we can create a sanitized subset if needed.

Appreciate the MAP - please add Esther when you update.

-Jane
Jane Doe
Product Lead, Search & Assistant | Acme Systems
jane.doe@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@acme.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-26T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & MAP draft - next steps

Thanks Jane - great, I'll add Esther (Procurement) and Gabriel (CFO) when you loop them in. Answers inline below and updated asks.

1) Baseline: Yes - we can run a mixed-traffic baseline. Monica will lead the benchmark plan (tail latency breakdowns + token cost analysis). We'll include 95/99/99.9 pctl and a synthetic mixed workload that mirrors your reported traffic split.

2) Test data: A sanitized subset is perfect. If you can share ~48-72 hours of representative logs (sanitized) and an S3 path for sample payloads, Monica's team will instrument the POC. We'll provide a checklist for safe data sharing.

Confirmed: kickoff Wed Apr 28, 10:00 PT - calendar invite sent.

Updated MAP notes:
- Add Esther Park (Procurement) and Gabriel Lee (CFO) as decision approvers.
- POC scope: staging deployment, 2 model variants, perf + cost report, security review.
- Target signature: 2027-05-20 (soft target based on procurement).

I attached a slightly updated MAP and scope sheet (acme-scope-sheet.xlsx) - see attachments. Dev, Laura: can you please review procurement constraints and draft a simple SOW template we can hand to Acme as part of procurement? Rishi: I'm asking you to own exec summary and pricing/discount proposal.

Thanks team - feel free to add anything I missed.

Best,
Marissa
